छ: छ 1. छ, the seventh consonant of the Sanskrit alphabet, being the aspirate of the preceding letter, and having the sound of chh in church-hill. —छ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound छ।
छ 2. छ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. छो), cutting, dividing; a part, a fragment.

छ 3. छ, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps connected with छो), pure, clean; trembling, tremulous, un-steady; (आ), f. covering, concealing (in this sense connected with rt. छद्); an infant, a child, any young animal (?); [cf. छा।]
छग: छग छग, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. छो), a goat; [cf. छाग; cf. also Germ. Bock; Angl. Sax. bucca; Old Germ. boch, poch, pog; Lat. caper; hircus (?); Hib. gabhar.]
छगल: छगल, अस्, m. a goat; a N. of Atri; of a Muni; of a country; (आ, ई), f. a she-goat; a kind of convolvulus, see the next; (अम्), n. blue cloth or raiment; [cf. छागल।] —छगलाङ्घ्री (°ल-अङ्°) or छगलाण्डी (°ल-अण्°), f. a plant, see the next. —छगलान्त्रिका or छगलान्त्री (°ल-अन्°), f. the plant Argyreia Speciosa or Argentea; a wolf; [cf. अजान्त्री।]
छगलिन्: छगलिन्, ई, m., N. of a preceptor who was him-self a pupil of Kalāpin; [cf. छागलेयिन्।]
छगण: छगण छगण, अस्, अम्, m. n. dried cow-dung; [cf. छागण।]
छज्जू: छज्जू छज्जू, ऊस्, m., N. of a man.
छटा: छटा छटा, f. a mass, lump, assemblage, number; a collection of rays of light, light, lustre, splendor; a straight or continuous line; [cf. जटा।] —छटा-फल, अस्, m. the betel-nut tree, palmyra tree. —छटाभा (°टा-आभा), f. lightning.
छण्डक: छण्डक छण्डक, a wrong form for छन्-दक।
छद्: छद् 1. छद्, cl. 10. P. (ep. also A.) छाद-यति, -ते, -यितुम् (also said to form छन्द-यति and cl. 1. P. छदति, but these forms do not seem to occur; in the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa a form छदयति is found), to cover, cover over, clothe, veil; to use anything as a cover, spread as a cover, cover one's self; to hide, conceal, keep secret; to protect: Desid. चिच्छादयिषति; [cf. Hib. scailim, ‘I shade, shelter;’ scailein, ‘a fan, umbrella,’ &c.: Gr. σκιά, σκοτός: Goth. scadus: Lith. skyda; Germ. Schild; schale: Goth. skal-ja: Lat. squāma; spolium.]
2. छद्, त्, त्, त्, (in compounds) concealing, hiding; [cf. धाम-च्छद्।]

छद् 3. छद् or छन्द्, cl. 10. P. A. छद-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, cl. 1. P. and 10. P. A., Ved. छन्दति, छन्दयति, -ते, चच्छन्द, Aor. अच्-छान्, छन्तुम्, to seem, appear, be considered or esteemed as; to seem good, please, be pleasant: A. छन्दयते, to be pleased with, delight in, approve of (with acc. or loc.); (Sāy.) to render celebrated or honoured: P. छन्दयति, to gratify a person (acc. or sometimes gen.) with anything (e. g. वरेण, with a boon), to present.
4. छद्, त्, त्, त्, (in compounds) pleased with &c.; [cf. कवि-च्छद्।]
छद् 5. छद्, cl. 1. P. छदति, &c., to nourish, strengthen.
छद् 6. छद्, cl. 1. and 10. P. छन्दति and छन्दयति, &c., to kindle; (a various reading for छृद्।)
छत्त्र: छत्त्र, अस्, m. (often spelt छत्र), a mush-room; N. of a kind of grass, = भू-तृण; a bee-hive of a conical or umbrella form; (आ), f., N. of several plants, viz. Anethum Sowa; also = अति-च्छत्त्र; coriander; N. of a plant supposed to grow in Kaśmīra; the plant Rubia Munjista; a mushroom; (अम्), n. a parasol, an umbrella, called Chattar by the natives, and regarded as an ensign of royal or delegated power; N. of a constellation; concealing the faults of a teacher (this meaning is invented for the explanation of the word छात्त्र); [cf. अति-च्छत्र, आकृति-च्छत्त्रा, गोमय-च्छ्°।] —छत्त्र-गुच्छ, अस्, m. the grass Scirpus Kysoor (कशेरु), = गुण्ड-तृण. —छत्त्र-गृह, अम्, n. the room in which the parasol (or badge of royalty) is kept. —छत्त्र-चक्र, अम्, n. an astrological diagram. —छत्त्र-धार, अस्, ई, अम्, bearing a parasol or umbrella, having or possessing one; (अस्), m. the bearer of a parasol. —छत्त्र-धारण, अम्, n. carrying or using a parasol or umbrella; carrying one as a type of royal authority. —छत्त्र-धार-त्व, अम्, n. the office of a parasol-bearer. —छत्त्र-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, = छत्र-धार above; (ई), m., N. of a son of Horila-siṃha. —छत्त्र-पति, इस्, or sometimes छत्त्र-प, अस्, m. ‘lord of the umbrella or parasol,’ title of an ancient king in Jambu-dvīpa, or of any king over whom a parasol is carried as a mark of dignity, (whence the title Satrap is probably derived.) —छत्त्र-पत्त्र, अम्, n., N. of the plant Ketmia Mutabilis. —छत्त्र-पुष्पक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = तिलक. —छत्-त्र-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breaking or destruction of the royal parasol, loss of dominion or empire, deposition, &c.; wilfulness, independence; a forlorn condition, widowhood. —छत्त्र-युक्ति, इस्, f. a chapter in king Bhoja's work called Yukti-kalpa-taru. —छत्त्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with an umbrella; (ती), f., N. of a country or town. —छत्त्रातिच्छत्त्र (°र-अत्°), अस्, आ, m. f. a fragrant grass described as growing in marshy ground, = छत्त्रक and अति-च्छत्त्रा। —छत्त्रा-धान्य, अम्, n. coriander.
छत्त्रक: छत्त्रक, अस्, m. a temple in honour of Śiva of a spherical or umbrella shape; a beehive of a conical form; the plant Asteracantha Longifolia; a mush-room; a kingfisher; (इका), f. a mushroom.
छत्त्राक: छत्त्राक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = जाल-वर्वू-रक; (ई), f., N. of a plant, = रास्ना; (अम्), n. a mushroom.
छत्त्रिक: छत्त्रिक, अस्, m. the bearer of a parasol.
छत्त्रिण: छत्त्रिण, अस्, m., N. of a man.
छत्त्रिन्: छत्त्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bearing or having a parasol or umbrella, belonging to one; (ई), m. a barber.
छत्त्वर: छत्त्वर, अस्, m. a house, a dwelling; a bower, an arbour.
छद: छद, अस्, m. a cover, covering (e. g. अल्प-च्छद, scantily covered or dressed; घन-च्छद, con-cealed by clouds); a wing; a leaf; N. of two plants, = ग्रन्थि-पर्ण and = तमाल; [cf. Hib. sgiath, ‘a wing.’] —छद-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the tree Sym-plocos Racemosa.
छदन: छदन, अम्, n. a cover, covering, a sheath, a scabbard; a wing; a leaf; the leaf of Laurus Cassia.
छदि: छदि = छदिस्, the roof of a carriage; a wing (?).
छदिस्: छदिस्, इस्, n. (f. ?), Ved. a cover, the roof of a carriage, the thatch or roof of a house.
छद्मन्: छद्मन्, अ, n. the thatch or roof of a house; external covering, a deceptive dress, disguise, masquerade; plea, pretext, pretence, trick, deceit; fraud, craft, dishonesty; [cf. Old Germ. scerm; Germ. Schirm.] —छद्म-तापस, अस्, m. a re-ligious hypocrite, a false ascetic. —छद्म-रू-पेण, ind. in disguise, incognito. —छद्म-वेश, अस्, m. a deceptive dress, disguise. —छद्म-वेशिन्, ई, m. dressed in disguise, a player, a cheat.
छद्मिका: छद्मिका, f. the plant Cocculus Cordifolius; [cf. गुडूची।]
छद्मिन्: छद्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) dis-guised, in an assumed dress or garb (e. g. ब्राह्मण-च्छद्मिन्, disguised as a Brāhman).
छन्न: छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, clad, concealed, secret, clandestine, private, solitary.
छन्न; add — (अम्), n. a covering; the trap-pings (of an elephant).
छात्त्र: छात्त्र, अस्, m. a pupil, scholar, disciple, tyro, novice, (as carrying his teacher's umbrella or as con-cealing his faults ?); (अम्), n. a kind of honey. —छात्त्र-गण्ड, अस्, m. an indifferent poetical scholar knowing only the beginnings of verses. —छात्त्र-गोमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, any one attendant on a pupil. —छात्त्र-ता, f. condition of a pupil, pupilage. —छात्त्र-दर्शन, अम्, n. fresh butter prepared from milk one day old (‘looked at by the pupils’). —छात्त्र-व्यंसक, अस्, m. a knavish or roguish pupil.
छात्त्रक: छात्त्रक, अम्, n. honey in the comb or hive.
छात्त्रिक्य: छात्त्रिक्य, अम्, n. the office of a parasol-bearer.
छाद: छाद, अम्, n. thatch, a roof; (an incorrect form.)
छादन: छादन, अस्, m. the plant Barleria Cærulea, = नीलाम्लान; (ई), f. hide, skin; (अम्), n. covering, a cover, screen; hiding, concealing; darkening; clothes; a leaf.
छादयत्: छादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, covering, veiling, shrouding.
छादित: छादित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, hidden, concealed; cut, divided (?).
छादिन्: छादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) hiding, covering.
छादिषेय: छादिषेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. छदिस्), suitable for the roof of a carriage or for the thatch of a house.
छाद्मिक: छाद्मिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. छद्मन्), fraudulent, dishonest; (अस्), m. a rogue.
छाद्यमान: छाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being covered.
छन्द: छन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasing, alluring, inviting; praising, a praiser; (अस्), m. appearance, look, shape; pleasure, delight, appetite, liking, fondness for, fancy, whim, predilection, desire, wish, subjection, will, free will, arbitrary choice; wilfulness, wilful conduct (e. g. मच्-छन्दात्, according to my wish or will, at my pleasure; स्व-च्छन्द, following one's own will, independent; अ-स्वच्छन्द, dependent; स्व-च्छन्-दम्, according to one's own wish; स्व-च्छन्दात्, willingly; अ-च्छन्देन, against the will); mean-ing, intention, purport, opinion; poison; (एन), ind. at the will of, according to wish or will, at one's pleasure; [cf. इन्द्र-च्छन्द, कलाप-च्°, देव-च्°, विजय-च्°, all meaning pearl-ornaments or neck-laces of various kinds; cf. also Lat. spons, sponte.] —छन्द-तस्, ind. at will, at pleasure, according to one's own wish or desire. —छन्दानुवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, indulging the humour, complying with the wishes. —छन्दानुवृत्त (°द-अन्°), अम्, n. indulgence of whims, humouring, compliance.
छन्दक: छन्दक in सर्व-च्छन्दक, epithet of Nārā-yaṇa, ‘assuming every shape?;’ (अस्), m., N. of the charioteer of Śākya-siṃha; [cf. छण्डक।] —छन्-दक-निवर्तन, ‘the return of Chandaka,’ N. of a Caitya. —छन्दक-पातन or छन्द-पातन, अस्, m. a hypocrite, a pretended or false ascetic.
छन्दन: छन्दन, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasing, charming.
छन्दस्: छन्दस्, अस्, n. desire, longing for, delight, pleasure, wish, will; free will; meaning, intention, purport, object; a sacred hymn or verse as distin-guished from the verses of the four Vedas, a verse which is neither Ṛc, nor Sāman, nor Yajus, nor Ātharvaṇa, originally perhaps a hymn or verse used in incantations; the sacred text of the Vedic hymns; metre in general, supposed to consist of three or seven typical forms; metrical science, prosody. —छन्दः-प्रकरण, अम्, n. a chapter on metre. —छन्दः-प्रशस्ति or छन्द-प्रशस्ति, इस्, f. a work by Harṣa. —छन्दः-शास्त्र, अम्, n. metrical science, a work on metre by Piṅgala. —छन्दः-सङ्ग्रह and छन्दः-सार, अस्, m. a work giving a summary of metres. —छन्दः-सिद्धि, इस्, f. a chapter of the Kāvya-kalpa-latā-vṛtti-parimala. —छन्दः-स्तुत्, त्, त्, त्, or छन्दः-स्तुभ्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. praising in hymns. —छन्दश्-चूडामणि, इस्, m. a work by Hema-candra. —छन्दस्-कृत, अम्, n. any metrical part of the Vedas or other sacred compositions. —छन्दस्-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose wing is sacred song, (borne aloft on the wings of praise ?). —छन्दस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. pleasing, lovely. —छन्दो-ग, अस्, m. (rt. गै), a reciter or singer in metre, a chanter of the Sāma-veda, generally the same as the Udgātṛ priest. —छन्दोग-परिशिष्ट, अम्, n. title of a work by Kātyāyana giving a supplement to Gobhila's Sūtras. —छन्दोग-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n. the Brāhmaṇa of the Udgātṛ priests attached to the Sāma-veda. Some authorities give eight of these Brāhmaṇas, the principal being called Prauḍha or Pañcaviṃśa, as consisting of twenty-five sections. —छन्दोग-माहकि, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —छन्दोग-शाखा, f. a branch of the Sāma-veda. —छान्दोग-श्रुति, इस्, f. the Veda of the Chandogas, the Sāma-veda. —छन्दोगाह्निक-पद्धति (°ग-अह्°), title of a work by Rāma-kṛṣṇa. —छन्दो-गोविन्द, title of a work on metre by Gaṅgā-dāsa. —छन्दो-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man, = मतङ्ग। —छन्दो-नामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having the name of metre, metrical. —छन्दोनुवृत्त (°दस्-अन्°), अम्, n. conforming to one's humour, humouring, indulgence. —छन्दो-भङ्ग, अस्, m. violation of the laws of metre. —छन्दो-भाषा, f. the language of the Vedas (?). —छन्दो-मञ्जरि, इस् or ई, f. title of a work on metre by Gaṅgā-dāsa. —छन्दो-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. consisting of or containing sacred hymns. —छन्दो-मान, अम्, n., Ved. the measure of metre, i. e. a syllable regarded as the metrical unit. —छन्दो-मार्तण्ड, अस्, m. title of a work on metre. —छन्दो-माला, f. title of a work on metre. —छन्दो-रुट्-स्तोम, अस्, m., N. of a Ṣaḍaha rite. —छन्दो-विचिति, इस्, f. ‘examination of metres,’ title of a treatise on metre. —छन्दो-विवृति, इस्, f. ‘explanation of metres,’ title of Piṅ-gala's work on metre. —छन्दो-वृत्त, अम्, n. a metre in general, any metre.
छन्दस्य: छन्दस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. taking the form of hymns, metrical, fit for hymns, relating to the Vedic hymns; made or done according to one's wish.
छन्दित: छन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, gratified, pleased.
छन्दु: छन्दु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. pleasing, lovely.
छन्दोम: छन्दोम, अस्, m., N. of the eighth, ninth, and tenth day in a sacrificial ceremony which lasts twelve days (द्वादशाह). —छन्दोम-त्रिककुद्, त्, m., N. of a Soma ceremony lasting three days. —छन्दोम-दशाह, अस्, m., N. of a Daśa-rātra. —छन्दोम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied by a Chandoma.
छद्वर: छद्वर छद्वर, अस्, m. a tooth (?); a bower; [cf. छत्त्वर।]
छनच्छन्: छनच्छन् छनच्छन्, ind. an imitative sound expressive of the noise of falling drops, of sobbing &c.; (according to some a reduplicated form of छनत्।)
छम्: छम् छम्, cl. 1. P. छमति, &c., to eat; [cf. चम्, जम्, झम्।]
छमच्छमिकारत्न: छमच्छमिकारत्न छमच्छमिका-रत्न, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
छमच्छमित: छमच्छमित छमच्छमित, अम्, n. (an ono-matopoetic word with the termination of the past pass. part.), crackling, rattling.
छमण्ड: छमण्ड छमण्ड, अस्, m. an orphan, a fatherless son; a single man, one who has no kins-men; [cf. छेमण्ड।]
छम्प्: छम्प् छम्प्, cl. 1. 10. P. छम्पति, छम्पयति, &c., to go, move.
छम्बट्: छम्बट् छम्बट्, ind., Ved. (used with rt. कृ, especially in sacrificial language), to make a failure, fail in obtaining or accomplishing.
छर्द्: छर्द् छर्द्, cl. 10. P. छर्दयति, -यितुम्, to vomit, be sick; [cf. छृद्; cf. also Hib. sceithim, ‘I vomit, spew;’ Lat. screo.]
छर्द: छर्द, अस्, m. (a various reading for छर्दि), vomiting.
छर्दन: छर्दन, अस्, m., N. of a plant (= अलम्बुष); of a Rākṣasa; another plant, = निम्ब; the plant Vangueria Spinosa; (अम्), n. vomiting, sickness; retching.
छर्दि: छर्दि, इस्, f. sickness, vomiting. —छर्दि-घ्न, अस्, m. ‘anti-emetic,’ N. of a tree, = निम्ब।
छर्दिका: छर्दिका, f. sickness, vomiting; a plant, = विष्णु-क्रान्ता. —छर्दिका-रिपु, उस्, m. small cardamoms (‘anti-emetic’).
छर्दिस्: 1. छर्दिस्, इस्, f. n. vomiting. (For 2. छर्दिस् see below.)
छर्दिस् 2. छर्दिस्, इस्, n. (fr. 1. छद् ?), Ved. a fence, a secure place, secure residence; a house; [cf. छदिस्।] —छर्दिष्-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. pro-tecting a house.
छर्दापनिका: छर्दापनिका छर्दापनिका, f. a kind of cu-cumber, = कर्कटी; (a corruption of छर्दापन-यिका ?).
छल्: छल् छल्, छलयति। See under छल।
छल: छल छल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably fr. 1. छद्), fraud, deceit, deception, sham, guise, dis-guise, pretence, pretext, delusion, illusion, semblance, counterfeit appearance, fiction, feint, circumvention, trick, stratagem; fallacy (e. g. वाक्-छलैः, with fallacious words); wickedness; design, device; in-tention; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Dala and descendant of Kuśa; छलात्, through deceit or fraud, deceitfully; छलेन, deceitfully, illusively, under the disguise or pretext or pretence of; उपदा-छलेन, under pre-tence of gifts of honour, i. e. with feigned gifts; रजश्-छलेन, under the semblance of dust; [cf. Lat. scelus.] —छल-कारक, अस्, आ, अम्, or छल-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, practising fraud or deceit, fraudulent. —छल-ता, f. fraud, deception, deceit.
छलक: छलक, अस्, इका, अम्, delusive, deceptive, cheating.
छलन: छलन, अम्, आ, n. f. deceiving, deluding, trick-ing, cheating, outwitting, feigning. —छलना-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, deceitful, cunning, crafty.

छेद्य: छेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cut or divided, divisible; to be cut off or amputated, to be split, to be muti-lated; (अम्), n. amputation, excision; [cf. कुड्य-च्छेद्य and पत्त्र-च्°।]
छैदिक: छैदिक, अस्, m. a ratan, a cane.
छिप्पिका: छिप्पिका छिप्पिका, f. a kind of bird (?); [cf. चिप्पिका।]
छिलिहिण्ड: छिलिहिण्ड छिलिहिण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = पाताल-गरुड।
छुच्छुन्दर: छुच्छुन्दर छुच्छुन्दर, अस्, m. or (इ, इस् or ई), f. the musk-rat or shrew.
छुच्छू: छुच्छू छुच्छू, ऊस्, f. or छुच्छू-पिङ्गला, f. a kind of animal.
छुट्: छुट् छुट् (a various reading for चुट्), cl. 6. 10. P. छुटति, छोटयति, &c., to cut; [cf. Hib. sgoth, ‘a cut;’ sgothan, ‘a small flock.’]
छुड्: छुड् छुड् (a various reading for थुड्), cl. 6. P. छुडति, &c., to cover.
छुड्ड: छुड्ड छुड्ड, अस्, m., N. of several men; (आ), f., N. of a woman.
छुद्र: छुद्र छुद्र, अम्, n. retaliation, counter-action, remedying; a ray.
छुप्: छुप् छुप्, cl. 6. P. छुपति, चुच्छोप, छोप्स्यति, अच्छौप्सीत्, छोप्तुम्, to touch.
छुप: छुप, अस्, m. touch, touching; a small tree, a shrub, a bush; air, wind; war, combat.
छुबुक: छुबुक छुबुक, अम्, n., Ved. the chin; [cf. चिवुक and चुबुक।]
छुर्: छुर् छुर्, cl. 6. P. छुरति, चुच्छोर, छुरितुम्, &c., to cut, engrave, incise, etch: Caus. छुरयति and छोरयति, -यितुम्, to inlay, veneer, to set with mosaic ornaments; [cf. क्षुर्; cf. also Hib. scuirim or sguirim, ‘I cease, desist,’ cf. छेद; Old Germ. scar, sciru, &c.; Mod. Germ. Schere.]
छुरित: छुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, inlaid, set, coated, spread; blended, intermingled. —छुरितोदर (°त-उद्°), अस्, ई, अम्, pierced through the belly; transfixed.
छूरिका: छूरिका, f. = छुरिका in छूरिका-पत्त्री, N. of a plant, = श्वेता, Andropogon Aciculatus; the mouth of a cow; (other readings have खुरिका, स्फुरिका, स्थुरिका, स्थूरिका।)
छोरण: छोरण छोरण। See under rt. छुर्।
छृद्: छृद् छृद्, cl. 7. P. छृणत्ति, चच्छर्द, छर्दिष्यति or छर्त्स्यति, छर्दितुम्, to pour out; P. and A. छृणत्ति, छृन्त्ते, &c., to play, shine; to vomit; cl. 1. P. छर्दति, &c., to kindle: Caus. छर्दयति, to pour out; to spit out, eject, vomit; to cause to spit; to kindle: Desid. चिच्छर्दिषति, -ते, or चिच्छृत्सति, -ते: Intens. चरीच्छृद्यते, चरिच्छर्त्ति; [cf. छर्द्; cf. also Lat. splendeo; Lith. spindẓiu, spindulys, skaistus, skaistas; Germ. glänzen ?].
छृप्: छृप् छृप् (a various reading for छृद्), cl. 1. 10. P. छर्पति, छर्पयति, &c., to kindle, inflame.
छेक: छेक छेक, अस्, आ, अम्, tame, domesticated (as a bird or beast); citizen, town-bred, shrewd, sharp, smart, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns; (with अनु-प्रास), a kind of alliteration, repe-tition of two or more consonants in different words; (अस्), m. a bee. —छेकोक्ति (°क-उक्°), इस्, f. indirect speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint.
छेकाल: छेकाल or छेकिल, अस्, आ, अम्, = छेक above.
छेमण्ड: छेमण्ड छेमण्ड, अस्, m. a fatherless child; [cf. छमण्ड and काचिघ।]
छेलु: छेलु छेलु, उस्, m. the plant Vernonia Anthelmintica.
छो: छो छो, cl. 4. P. छ्यति, चच्छौ, छास्-यति, अच्छात् or अच्छासीत्, छातुम्, to cut, divide, mow, reap: Caus. P. छाययति।
छोज: छोज छोज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
छोटिका: छोटिका छोटिका, f. snapping the thumb and forefinger together.
छोटिन्: छोटिन् छोटिन्, ई, m. (said to be fr. rt. छो), a fisherman.
छोलङ्ग: छोलङ्ग छोलङ्ग, अस्, m. = मातुलु ग, a citron, lime; [cf. अम्बु-केशर।]
छ्यु: छ्यु छ्यु, cl. 1. A. छ्यवते, &c., to go, move, approach.
छलितराम: छलित-राम; for ‘अस्, m.’ read अम्, n.
